units.title: Bootstrap the conference application repository
units.acceptanceCriteria: A fresh checkout builds the application against a pinned engine contract and displays an explicit service-unavailable state when backends are absent. No copied engine implementation appears in app source.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run clean-install, package-boundary, routing and error-state tests. Validate cross-repository dependency/version records.
sourceMetadata.security: Separate browser configuration from server secrets and apply baseline session, content-security and dependency policies.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Create the separate application workspace, branded shell, route structure, API boundary, test harness and app-owned plan/handoff ledger. Consume versioned engine interface packages through a dependency lock; keep generic world functionality in the engine.

units.title: Connect identities organizations and guest access
externalPrerequisites: Configured test and production identity-provider credentials where a hosted provider is selected
units.acceptanceCriteria: Registered and authorized guest users can establish the intended identity and request scoped grants. Session expiry and logout invalidate the application session and further grant issuance. C05 and C19 verify revocation of existing connections across engine services.

sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise a real test identity provider, session renewal, guest reuse/expiry, cross-organization access and logout across tabs.
sourceMetadata.security: Verify token audience, issuer, nonce and role mapping. Store minimum profile data and prevent a client-supplied organization or role from becoming authoritative.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement organizer accounts, organization membership, participant profiles, guest invite identity and an identity-provider adapter. Exchange application identity for scoped engine grants; define session expiry, logout and account recovery boundaries.

units.title: Implement events sessions and schedule persistence
units.acceptanceCriteria: Organizers can create and publish an event with multiple sessions; participants see only published sessions they may access. Schedule changes preserve stable links and explicit cancellation status.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test daylight-saving boundaries, timezone rendering, overlapping sessions, concurrent edits and database migrations.
sourceMetadata.security: Authorize every mutation by organization and event; prevent public discovery of private event details.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add event/session records, draft and published states, time zones, organizer ownership, session types and links to engine world templates/instances. Implement edits, cancellation and optimistic conflict detection.

units.title: Implement registration invitations and admission records
units.acceptanceCriteria: A valid invitation admits its intended user according to capacity and event policy; duplicate registration is idempotent and revocation takes effect. Waitlist promotion does not overbook under concurrent requests.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test duplicate submissions, invitation expiry/replay, capacity races and cancellation/re-registration.
sourceMetadata.security: Bind grants to event and intended identity, throttle abuse and avoid exposing the attendee directory through invitation lookup.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add registration, capacity/waitlist records, revocable invitation links and attendee check-in. Support organizer-managed invitations and direct link sharing before optional notification delivery is connected.

units.title: Map conference roles to engine capabilities
units.acceptanceCriteria: Changing a role updates world, media and editing access consistently; a speaker does not automatically gain venue administration or access to other events.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run table-driven policy tests and multi-service revocation/race cases, including stale tokens and concurrent promotions.
sourceMetadata.security: Enforce roles on server endpoints and grants. Verify least privilege and prevent role escalation through UI state or modified requests.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement attendee, host, speaker and exhibitor role policies as application-owned mappings to engine join, speak, present, edit and moderation capabilities. Add live promotion, demotion and scoped delegation.

units.title: Build the event lobby agenda and participant directory
units.acceptanceCriteria: A participant can find the next session and locate authorized people or rooms using keyboard or touch. Private attendee/profile fields remain hidden according to policy.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test search/filter combinations, timezone changes, accessibility navigation and private/public directory boundaries.
sourceMetadata.security: Sanitize event/profile content and enforce visibility rules on the API, including search result counts.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Provide event landing pages, agenda filters, session details, search, attendee-visible directory settings and clear paths to join available rooms. Display local time and session state without requiring a 3D client.

units.title: Connect the venue and shared asset library
units.acceptanceCriteria: An organizer can import a venue, track processing and select a published revision for an event. Failed conversion preserves the source and provides actionable diagnostics.

sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise successful, interrupted and failed imports plus cross-organization asset references and template cloning.
sourceMetadata.security: Check upload/export grants, storage ownership and private source retrieval; vendor policies do not remove engine capabilities.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Expose engine venue templates and organization asset collections in event setup. Support import progress, preview, clone, version selection and quotas using the engine APIs and editor rather than duplicating converters.

units.title: Build the host venue setup and rehearsal workflow
units.acceptanceCriteria: A host can prepare a complete room, preview four overlapping tracks and wall-video sound, rehearse presentations and publish the tested layout without changing an active session accidentally.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run setup-to-rehearsal-to-publish tests with saved-world reload and concurrent organizer edits.
sourceMetadata.security: Keep rehearsal membership separate from published session access; enforce entity-level editing and presenter rights.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Compose engine editing tools into event preparation: spawn locations, screen placement, stage access, seats, music, environmental audio and prop layout. Add rehearsal sessions and save/publish a venue revision.

units.title: Build device preflight and join onboarding
units.acceptanceCriteria: A user can join with voice only, camera, VR or the accessible view; permission denial and unavailable hardware lead to usable alternatives. Audio starts from a deliberate join interaction.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test denied permissions, missing devices, output changes, restrictive networks, headset sleep and keyboard-only operation on real browser/device profiles.
sourceMetadata.security: Do not activate capture before user intent; redact device identifiers and avoid leaking room access tokens in diagnostics.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Provide microphone/speaker/camera selection, audio unlock, network/media checks, quality selection, accessibility choices and desktop/VR entry. Explain actual unavailable capabilities and preserve user choices between reconnects.

units.title: Implement lobby admission room entry and recovery
units.acceptanceCriteria: An admitted user reaches the correct session with matching world/media authorization. Expired or revoked users are rejected, and reconnect cannot accidentally join a different event.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run multi-client admission races, worker loss, token expiry, full room and network reconnection scenarios.
sourceMetadata.security: Coordinate grants across services, revoke on removal and prevent open-redirect or arbitrary room-ID entry.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Connect session admission to engine room placement, waiting areas and media join. Implement leave, reconnect, full-room alternatives and clear recovery when a worker is replaced.

units.title: Build participant avatar presence and personal controls
units.acceptanceCriteria: Participants see correct identity/presence and hear voices follow avatars. Personal mute, volume and comfort settings persist without changing other participants settings.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test two-user avatar changes, seat transitions, personal audio controls and XR/desktop switching without duplicate listeners or streams.
sourceMetadata.security: Prevent identity impersonation and unauthorized avatar asset access; distinguish local mute from host moderation.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Expose avatar selection, profile labels, seating, locomotion preferences, push-to-talk/mute and per-source listening controls through engine APIs. Support equivalent essential controls in desktop and immersive UI.

units.title: Build the presentation and shared file workflow
units.acceptanceCriteria: An authorized presenter can place content on a wall, loop a video with localized sound, hand off control and support late joiners at the current slide/time. Unsupported files remain accessible attachments.

sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise slide and video handoffs, capture cancellation, browser audio capture limits, reconnect and simultaneous presenter requests.
sourceMetadata.security: Validate presenter leases and content access; screen capture uses explicit browser source selection and displays capture state.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add upload/share controls, screen targeting, slide navigation, looping video, live desktop sharing, presenter handoff and paired-desktop presentation for headset users. Preserve engine spatial sound defaults.

units.title: Build spatial networking and private conversation flows
units.acceptanceCriteria: Walking between groups changes the audible public mix smoothly. Joining a private conversation requires authorization; leaving or removal revokes media access rather than merely lowering volume.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test two overlapping public conversations and a private group, with late joins, blocked users and boundary movement.
sourceMetadata.security: Verify membership and subscriptions server-side, including revoked users reconnecting with stale grants.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Provide nearby-person discovery, walk-up conversation, personal blocking and explicit private conversation membership using engine spatial media and capability interfaces.

units.title: Implement workshop and breakout orchestration
units.acceptanceCriteria: Hosts can move an authorized group into independent rooms and return them predictably. World state, conversation membership and encryption state correspond to the destination.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test concurrent assignments, full/failed destinations, interrupted transfers, host reconnect and return timers.
sourceMetadata.security: Revoke source-room grants according to policy and never transfer private breakout media to other groups accidentally.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add creation, assignment, voluntary selection, timed return and host movement between breakout instances. Preserve shared session resources through explicit access links and rejoin state.

units.title: Build exhibition booths and interactive venue experiences
units.acceptanceCriteria: An exhibitor can prepare their assigned area and interact with visitors without editing neighboring booths. Shared objects and presentations preserve their configured physics and audio behavior.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run two exhibitor/visitor sessions with scoped edits, saved layouts, walking routes and interactive props.
sourceMetadata.security: Enforce booth/entity boundaries, object quotas and safe behavior capabilities; do not accept arbitrary uploaded scripts as trusted application code.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add exhibitor-scoped booth configuration, shared exhibits, reusable prop placement and guided venue experiences. Hosts can configure animated animals, media walls and sound features using engine components.

units.title: Build keynote backstage and audience orchestration
units.acceptanceCriteria: Multiple audience instances receive the same program through actual distribution, and promotion creates a working interactive connection without feedback or duplicate audio.

sourceMetadata.tests: Rehearse program switching, relay failure, delayed viewers, stage promotion/demotion and multiple audience instances.
sourceMetadata.security: Keep backstage tracks private; grant stage publication deliberately and include relays/recorders in the stated encryption trust boundary.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement backstage preparation, stage program selection, bounded audience instances, speaker queue and authorized audience-to-stage promotion. Align slides and interaction timing with live or broadcast delivery delay.

units.title: Implement moderated questions polls and audience interaction
units.acceptanceCriteria: Hosts can queue questions and open/close polls; eligible participants submit according to policy and see accurate results without duplicate counting after reconnect.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test concurrent answers, duplicate retries, delayed viewers, poll closure races and moderator handoff.
sourceMetadata.security: Enforce eligibility, rate limits and moderation scopes; sanitize participant content and prevent unauthorized result access.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add moderated questions, polling, hand raising and response summaries. Associate interactions with event/session IDs and the viewers program timeline where broadcast delay matters.

units.title: Build shared notes whiteboards and annotation workflows
units.acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent participants can edit permitted content, reconnect and retrieve the intended final document. Annotations stay attached to the right asset revision and page.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test concurrent edits, reconnect replay, page changes, export and permission revocation without document divergence.
sourceMetadata.security: Protect document membership and stored content; reject unauthorized operations even when the client caches a prior document.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Expose engine collaborative documents as session notes, whiteboards and presentation annotations. Add ownership, save/export, reconnect and accessible editing views tied to the same shared state.

units.title: Build host moderation and participant protection
units.acceptanceCriteria: A removed user loses relevant access promptly and cannot retain an active microphone or edit lease. Local blocking and event-level moderation have distinct understandable effects.

sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise simultaneous moderation/reconnect, expired bans, host handoff and attempts to retain stale connections or leases.
sourceMetadata.security: Audit administrative actions without recording private conversation content by default; prevent cross-event moderation and privilege escalation.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Provide host mute, removal, ban, restricted editing, incident context and participant blocking controls. Apply actions consistently across world, text, media and presentation services with appropriate expiry.

units.title: Build privacy recording captions and retention controls
units.acceptanceCriteria: A private session has no undisclosed processing endpoint; enabling recording/captions shows the actual trust change. Authorized users can retrieve retained material and deletion follows the configured policy.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test key rotation, recorder entry/removal, late joins, caption failure, playback authorization and retention expiry.
sourceMetadata.security: Keep keys and processing visibility accurate; no blanket E2EE claim for material intentionally decrypted by converters, relays or recording endpoints.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Expose session privacy modes, admitted recording/caption endpoints, recording status, participant notices and retention/access controls. Support captions in 3D and 2D and manage permitted recordings/transcripts after sessions.

units.title: Complete accessible participation and localization foundations
units.acceptanceCriteria: A participant can register, join, listen, present where permitted, use notes/questions and leave without relying on 3D navigation or a pointer. The selected listening policy is explicit.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run keyboard and screen-reader task scripts, zoom/contrast/reduced-motion checks, long translations and right-to-left layout fixtures.
sourceMetadata.security: Keep accessible routes subject to the same access and recording rules; do not expose additional private content through alternate views.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Complete a 2D meeting path with readable presentations, captions, keyboard controls, semantic labels, focus recovery and reduced motion. Externalize interface strings, locale/time formatting and text direction for future language packs.

units.title: Connect notifications and calendar delivery
externalPrerequisites: Authorized email delivery account and verified sending domain for live delivery qualification
units.acceptanceCriteria: A real test recipient receives the correct invitation/update and calendar times; retries do not send duplicates and disabled delivery is shown honestly. Link sharing remains available independently.

sourceMetadata.tests: Use a sandbox provider and one authorized real delivery test; test failures, retries, timezone updates and preference enforcement.
sourceMetadata.security: Protect provider credentials, validate recipients and avoid leaking attendee lists or private session details. Delivery occurs only under configured organizer/user actions.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement an outbound notification adapter, event invitations, schedule-change reminders and calendar-file generation. Connect one selected production delivery provider, with retries, bounce handling, preference controls and idempotent sends.

units.title: Build organizer administration and operational reporting
units.acceptanceCriteria: An organizer can diagnose a failed join or import and see accurate service health without accessing private media. Reports distinguish attendance, concurrent users and subscribed/publishing media counts.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test report reconciliation against known scenarios, privacy filtering, stale data labels and threshold alerts.
sourceMetadata.security: Restrict operational data by organization and role; log safe identifiers and audit sensitive administrative changes.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add organizer dashboards for session readiness, attendance, room health, storage, conversion failures, usage budgets and exportable event reports. Provide administrative controls through scoped engine/application APIs.

units.title: Run the complete conference rehearsal suite
externalPrerequisites: Representative human/device rehearsal participants and provisioned external services
units.acceptanceCriteria: The complete event succeeds across the declared device/network profiles. Failures become tracked fixes; a passing unit suite cannot substitute for the user journey or actual provider/hardware evidence.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run multi-client browser tests and real-device/real-service rehearsal with network interruption, media handoff and recovery.
sourceMetadata.security: Repeat cross-tenant, revoked-role, private-room and recording-boundary cases during the integrated journey.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Create an automated event rehearsal plus a real participant/headset script covering preparation, registration, keynote, breakouts, exhibits, shared files, spatial audio, moderation and post-event access. Record actual environment and service versions.

units.title: Deploy and verify the conference application release candidate
externalPrerequisites: Hosting account, domain/DNS access and production service credentials
units.acceptanceCriteria: A production-like environment serves the application over the intended domain and passes public-path join/presentation checks. Deployment, rollback and restore evidence is attached to the actual commit/version.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run deployment smoke, migration compatibility, expired-secret, restore and rollback drills through the real ingress path.
sourceMetadata.security: Review TLS, CSP, cookies, CORS, secrets, administrative access and environment isolation before promotion.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add deployable frontend/API configuration, migrations, secret references, health checks, canary promotion and rollback. Publish operator/admin documentation, self-contained handoff and truthful status integration for the project tracker.

units.title: Accept the complete conference release
units.acceptanceCriteria: All planned conference capabilities and required expanded engine lanes are verified; no mock provider, unavailable native connector or failed gate is labeled complete. The deployed release passes the final event rehearsal.

sourceMetadata.tests: Repeat critical production smoke and reference-event tests on the release build; verify links to immutable CI, security, deployment and recovery evidence.
sourceMetadata.security: Perform a separately recorded final security review and close unresolved blocking findings without weakening required repository checks.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Reconcile every application card, required engine capability, external dependency and release scenario. Publish supported device/capacity/format profiles, known limits, versioned runbooks, acceptance evidence and final progress records.

units.title: Define credit prices and versioned provider cost catalogs
units.acceptanceCriteria: A quote is reproducible from its versioned inputs and uses integer monetary/credit units. Rodin/Meshy provider credits are never equated with platform credits. Pricing can change without changing engine capabilities or rewriting past transactions.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test rounding, currency/rate precision, stale catalogs, markup changes, bundled provider discounts, quote expiry and historical replay.
sourceMetadata.security: Authorize catalog changes, audit them and prevent client-supplied wholesale prices or discount/exemption flags.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Define platform credit denomination, currency conversion, provider rate cards, generation/runtime markup and pricing versions. Start with a configurable 2x markup default, with explicit treatment of fees, tax, storage, retries and included allowances; separate wholesale cost from customer price.

units.title: Implement the credit wallet and immutable accounting ledger
units.acceptanceCriteria: Simultaneous generation and NPC turns cannot spend the same credits twice. Corrections append balancing entries; a payment processors eventual invoice state cannot temporarily grant unlimited work.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run real transactional database concurrency, crash/retry, duplicate events, expiry, reservation release, reconciliation and negative-balance prevention tests.
sourceMetadata.security: Restrict ledger mutations to authenticated services; retain audit provenance without logging payment instruments or private conversations.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Build an append-only double-entry credit ledger with paid/promotional/recurring grants, available/reserved balances, idempotent reserve/settle/release, reversals and reconciliation. Keep the application ledger authoritative for immediate spend admission.

units.title: Sell a la carte credits through verified payments
externalPrerequisites: Payment processor test account and webhook signing credentials; live merchant configuration before production
units.acceptanceCriteria: Credits appear exactly once after a verified successful payment, including duplicate/out-of-order webhook delivery and a user closing checkout. A browser success redirect cannot mint credits.

sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise real processor test-mode checkout, failed/asynchronous payment, webhook signatures/retries, duplicate delivery, refunds and reconciliation.
sourceMetadata.security: Keep card collection with the processor, scope keys and validate raw-body signatures and event/account ownership.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Integrate a replaceable payment adapter, initially Stripe Checkout, for one-time credit purchases, receipts and refunds. Verify signed webhooks, store event identities and reconcile with provider records before granting spendable credits.

units.title: Implement subscriptions with monthly credit grants
units.acceptanceCriteria: Each paid subscription period grants its allowance once. Failed renewals and delayed webhooks produce the declared access/grace behavior. Mid-cycle changes and repeated plan switching cannot multiply allowances or reset consumed quota.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run processor test-clock renewals, dunning, cancellation, proration, duplicate/out-of-order invoices, annual-with-monthly-allowance schedules if offered, and grant expiry/rollover.
sourceMetadata.security: Use server entitlement state and reconcile processor/account identities. Changes affecting recurring charges require a concrete user-confirmed price.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add recurring plans, monthly credit allowances, optional NPC-slot add-ons, upgrades/downgrades, cancellation, renewal, grace states, carryover/expiry policy and customer billing management. Pin plan terms at purchase and issue grants from verified paid invoice periods.

units.title: Apply administrator exemptions while retaining platform costs
units.acceptanceCriteria: Admins can use the features without a credit deduction or paid subscription requirement. Non-admin requests cannot obtain the exemption by editing the client, NPC prompt or request body. Reports still show the company's actual expense.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test zero balance admin use, role revocation, cross-organization authority, forged exemption claims and cost reconciliation without customer debit. Confirm an exempt admin with no paid slot receives an authorized platform-funded lease.
sourceMetadata.security: Resolve exemptions through trusted application authorization and audit overrides; never encode an unverified isAdmin flag in engine authority.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement trusted server-side administrator billing exemptions. Generation, conversation and NPC operation charge exempt admins zero credits while preserving real provider usage, internal cost attribution and ordinary authorization/resource controls. Issue platform-funded reservations and engine operating leases for exempt use; preserve the distinction between zero customer debit and nonzero wholesale resource cost.

units.title: Quote and authorize generation and operating spend
units.acceptanceCriteria: Before paid creation the user sees X credits, what is included, the maximum charge and the chosen operating mode/cap. Price changes, extra retries or new stages exceeding that approval require a new quote. Admin quotes show zero customer charge.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test stale/tampered quotes, simultaneous acceptance, cancellation, partial provider failure, estimate reconciliation, charge ceilings and never-started refunds.
sourceMetadata.security: Bind quotes to principal, NPC/job, inputs, pricing version and nonce; client estimates never authorize spending.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Connect engine cost estimates to itemized platform-credit quotes, expiry, maximum authorized total, initial operating funding and atomic reservation. Show one-time creation cost separately from recurring/usage operation, apply approved markup and release unused reserved credits.

units.title: Allocate NPC subscription slots and operating allowances
units.acceptanceCriteria: A user can assign an existing NPC to an unused slot or buy an add-on, then remove it. Removing the last eligible funding source freezes it. Slot reassignment does not reset used allowances, and included slots do not imply unbounded inference.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test concurrent assignments, exceeded slot count, downgrade, transfer, renewal failure, exhausted included usage, no-overage mode and explicit supplemental credit approval.
sourceMetadata.security: Issue scoped short-lived engine operating leases from authoritative entitlement state; revoke them consistently on funding loss.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement assignment/removal of NPCs to purchased or included slots. Each plan defines concurrent active slots, included operating allowance, model/voice/service tier and explicit overage choice. Track consumption across slot transfers and billing periods.

units.title: Integrate conjuring and object creation into conference worlds
units.acceptanceCriteria: A participant with creation permission can complete the live pipeline from a world UI, understand one-time and operating charges, and choose wallet funding or a slot. Missing funds preserve already-created assets and expose repair/resume actions.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run desktop/VR user journeys for props and NPCs, admin exemption, denied permission, cancellation, partial results, late completion and cross-world inventory reuse.
sourceMetadata.security: Verify event/world creation capabilities separately from billing authority. Private reference images and conversations follow their defined access scopes.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Connect in-world text/voice creation to permissions, quote acceptance, image previews, progress, placement and first conversation. Offer an Einstein-style educational NPC preset while supporting arbitrary creator-defined objects and NPCs through the general engine.

units.title: Give creators operating budgets and NPC lifecycle controls
units.acceptanceCriteria: Creators can bound opex, stop future spending and later resume the same NPC. Frozen/inaccessible state is clear to visitors. Forecasts are labeled estimates; no silent recharge or indefinite background conversation is enabled.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test budget races, low-funds notices, caps mid-turn, disconnected owner, recurring cancellation, model downgrade, resume and persisted memory.
sourceMetadata.security: Reauthorize funding changes and keep financial dashboards separate from other visitors private conversation content.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add per-NPC and account budget dashboards, daily/monthly caps, model/voice limits, usage forecasts, funding priority, optional explicitly authorized top-up and freeze/resume controls. Show creation cost, recurring commitments, incurred usage and remaining allowance separately.

units.title: Publish creator-controlled subscribable NPCs
units.acceptanceCriteria: Only NPCs explicitly enabled by an authorized creator become subscribable. A subscription grants the advertised interactions, not ownership or access to other users memories. Disabling new sales handles existing paid periods explicitly.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test private/unlisted/public publication, creator authority, pricing updates, existing subscriptions, access revocation, abuse reporting and shared/private memory boundaries.
sourceMetadata.security: Validate creator ownership and permitted content publication; protect subscription and memory ACLs independently.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Let a creator enable or disable NPC subscriptions and set access level, price, included visitor usage, concurrency, visibility, renewal terms and shared-knowledge policy. Keep private conversations private and version changes to subscriber entitlements.

units.title: Bill NPC subscribers and grant interaction access
units.acceptanceCriteria: A visitor can subscribe to an enabled NPC, use the advertised allowance and cancel future renewal. Creator deletion/freeze, failed payment and unavailable service follow the visible credit/refund/access policy.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run processor test-mode NPC subscriptions, renewals, failed payments, duplicate events, concurrent sessions and entitlement revocation.
sourceMetadata.security: Bind subscriptions to the intended NPC/version/customer and enforce interaction allowance on the server.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement NPC-specific recurring purchases, cancellation, renewal and entitlements through the payment adapter. Define subscriber interaction allowances and optional overages separately from funding contributions; collect revenue and grant access through verified payment events.

units.title: Allocate subscriber revenue to company margin and NPC operation
units.acceptanceCriteria: Additional subscribers can reduce the creators payable operating cost to zero while retaining the configured company share. Net cash, credit liabilities, operating subsidy and consumed service are distinct; no receipt is counted twice as revenue or funding.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test accounting identities, enough-subscriber/zero-creator-cost cases, partial periods, refunds/disputes after subsidy use, rollover, insufficient funding and historical rate replay.
sourceMetadata.security: Use immutable settlement records and restricted policy changes; isolate financial entitlements from model-generated claims and client balances.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement versioned settlement of verified subscriber receipts into processor/tax costs, company share and an NPC operating subsidy pool. Apply subsidies against the creators eligible operating bill with a floor of zero; define reserve/rollover and refund reversal rules.

units.title: Coordinate wallet, slot and subscriber funding for NPC operation
units.acceptanceCriteria: Removing a creator slot does not freeze an otherwise funded NPC. With no eligible funding it freezes after bounded in-flight work; renewing a slot or adding credits/subscriber funding restores access and memory. No funding source is double-debited. Exempt administrator operation remains available at zero customer charge while its real usage settles to the platform cost account.

sourceMetadata.tests: Test simultaneous funding changes, last-payer loss, fan demand exceeding allowance, bounded queue/concurrency, grace expiry, fair allocation, split settlement and resume. Cover administrator platform funding, exemption revocation, and separation from subscriber/creator debits.
sourceMetadata.security: Authorize every funding source and preserve reservation provenance across engine/app failures; never infer spending permission from a public NPC listing.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement an atomic funding arbiter using the creators declared priority among included slot allowance, NPC subscriber subsidy and approved wallet spend. Budget for subscriber consumption as well as creator sessions, issue engine leases and checkpoint when eligible funding ends. Include trusted administrator exemptions as platform-funded reservations and leases, without consuming a customer wallet or requiring a paid NPC slot.

units.title: Operate billing reconciliation refunds and financial recovery
units.acceptanceCriteria: Operators can trace a charge from quote through provider usage, payment and ledger entries, repair discrepancies with reversals, and explain admin-funded expense. Financial failures do not silently delete a creators NPC or leak conversations.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run webhook outage/backfill, duplicate billing, refunded consumed credits, chargebacks, reconciliation repair, ledger invariant audits and least-privilege operator access.
sourceMetadata.security: Separate operational roles, audit sensitive adjustments, redact payment/private data and restrict production payment keys.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add payment/usage reconciliation, credit adjustments, refund/dispute handling, fraud/rate controls, pricing operations and margin/cost reporting. Surface provider invoice variance, expiring reservations and failed settlements. Preserve dormant NPC assets/memories through financial recovery.

units.title: Qualify the complete NPC credits and subscription business flow
externalPrerequisites: Payment test environment, live generation/conversation providers, approved test-spend budget and supported devices
units.acceptanceCriteria: A generated English Einstein-style NPC remembers its permitted user context, has spatial speech, settles actual approved creation usage within the maximum and releases unused credits, obeys operating caps and resumes unchanged after funding restoration. Subscriber funding demonstrably reduces creator cost while retaining company share. Actual production payment configuration is checked separately before launch.

sourceMetadata.tests: Run end-to-end browser/headset journeys, payment renewal simulations, concurrency/overspend, privacy, partial failure, refunds, slot movement and account recovery; retain reconciled cost and ledger evidence.
sourceMetadata.security: Complete separate integrated review of payment trust, spend authorization, provider keys, persona/tool boundaries and private memory. Resolve blocking findings before deployment.
sourceMetadata.deliverable: Run full generation and lifecycle scenarios with real engine/provider behavior and payment test-mode transactions; measure margins and user-visible charges. Cover one-time purchases, recurring credits, slots, admins, creator subscribers, exhaustion, freezing and restoration before the conference release rehearsal.
